photos.title: sisters-picnic-est-2001.jpg — Two sisters on a picnic quilt with an EST 2001 letterboard
photos.alt: Two smiling women sit close together on a quilt in a field, one with her arm around the other, beside a letterboard reading EST 2001 and a plate of wings.

photos.title: sisters-piggyback.jpg — Sister piggyback ride on a wooded path
photos.alt: One woman carries the other on her back along a grassy path between trees, both laughing at the camera.

photos.title: sisters-glitter-hug.jpg — Sisters hugging with glitter at sunset
photos.alt: Two women hug tightly with their eyes closed and glitter on their cheeks, with a soft sunset behind them.

photos.title: boy-christmas-tree-farm-sign.jpg — Boy in red plaid at a Christmas tree farm sign
photos.alt: A smiling boy in a red checked shirt stands in front of a hay bale and a Christmas Tree Farm sign, with lit trees behind him.

photos.title: christmas-sisters-truck-bed.jpg — Two girls in a red truck bed with a Christmas tree
photos.alt: Two young girls in red plaid dresses sit in the bed of a red pickup beside a flocked Christmas tree.

photos.title: family-red-truck-christmas-farm.jpg — Family of four at the Christmas tree farm truck
photos.alt: Parents in red hold their two young sons beside a red pickup truck and a Christmas Tree Farm sign.

photos.title: couple-stone-planter-golden-hour.jpg — Couple beside a stone planter in warm light
photos.alt: A smiling man in a rust jacket holds a woman in a brown velvet coat beside a large stone planter.

photos.title: family-driftwood-bench-christmas.jpg — Family of three on a driftwood bench at Christmas
photos.alt: A couple in red plaid sits on a driftwood bench with their toddler, beside a flocked tree and poinsettias.

photos.title: sisters-driftwood-bench.jpg — Two sisters on a driftwood bench
photos.alt: Two girls sit at either end of a driftwood bench in front of a flocked Christmas tree, smiling at the camera.

photos.title: usf-graduate-with-mom.jpg — Graduate with her mom in a USF Mom shirt
photos.alt: A graduate in a green cap and gown stands beside her mother, who wears a USF Mom T-shirt, under a lit pergola.

photos.title: usf-graduate-white-dress-trees.jpg — Graduate in a white dress among the trees
photos.alt: A graduate in a green cap and a white dress sits on the grass in a tree-lined park at dusk.

photos.title: usf-graduate-white-dress-standing.jpg — Graduate in a white dress with confetti
photos.alt: A graduate in a green cap and white dress stands on a confetti-strewn path with trees behind her.

photos.title: usf-graduate-university-sign-dog.jpg — Graduate with her dog at the USF sign
photos.alt: A graduate in a green gown holds a small dog in a matching cap and gown in front of the University of South Florida sign.

photos.title: usf-graduate-bull-statue.jpg — Graduate beside the bull statue at sunset
photos.alt: A graduate in a green gown flashes the Bulls horns sign beside a bronze bull statue at sunset.

photos.title: usf-graduate-champagne-toast.jpg — Graduate and partner toasting with champagne
photos.alt: A graduate in a lit green cap and a man in a USF pullover clink champagne flutes on a path at dusk.

photos.title: couple-matching-green-plaid.jpg — Couple in matching green plaid by a fence
photos.alt: A woman in a green plaid dress and a man in a matching shirt stand together by a white fence.

photos.title: couple-dogs-red-truck-christmas.jpg — Couple with two dogs in a red truck at Christmas
photos.alt: A couple in holiday sweaters sits in the bed of a red pickup with two small dogs in Santa hats and a flocked tree.

photos.title: couple-christmas-tree-lights.jpg — Couple in holiday sweaters by a lit tree
photos.alt: A woman rests her head against a man in a Santa hat and reindeer sweater in front of a lit Christmas tree.

photos.title: couple-holiday-sweaters-balustrade.jpg — Couple in holiday sweaters at a stone balustrade
photos.alt: A couple in holiday sweaters stands at a stone balustrade with a red and gold bow in the foreground.
